crossRefs.note: The prophet came near to the king of Israel, and said to him, “Go, strengthen yourself, and mark, and see what you do…
The Philistines made a another raid in the valley.

parallels.note: Now the Philistines had come and made a raid in the valley of Rephaim.
The Philistines made a another raid in the valley.

translations.web: The Philistines came up yet again, and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.
translations.bsb: Once again the Philistines came up and spread out in the Valley of Rephaim.
